blocks.text: RIYADH, Saudi Arabia — At least 12 people were killed and 309 others wounded Saturday in a strike on Riyadh’s international airport, Saudi Arabia’s civil aviation officials said—an attack that a diplomatic source blamed on Yemen’s Houthis. Four Saudi citizens were among the dead, as well as two Bangladeshis, one US citizen, one Egyptian, one Jordanian, one Syrian, one Palestinian, and one Sudanese, the statement added. Some of the wounded were in serious condition. The Iran-backed Houthis have unleashed a wave of strikes against the kingdom on an unprecedented scale, targeting Saudi airports, oil facilities, and tankers since a truce in […]...
